title: Security Risk Brief: Thursday, October 22, 2026
notes_html:
• Kenya raised to Level 3, Reconsider Travel, on Oct 19 (TravelGov)
  • US ordered departure of non-emergency government staff and families from Saudi Arabia only, Oct 21 (statedeptspox); King Fahd airport attack, Oct 21 (Reuters); Houthi attack at Al-Rayyan airport, Yemen, Oct 21 (TracTerrorism)
  • Critical PHP web vulnerability takes government sites offline, Oct 21 to 22 (Reuters, TheStudyofWar)
  • China-aligned Storm-0940 AI-assisted attacks and ConnectWise compromise, Oct 21 (MsftSecIntel)
  • Treasury sanctions on Iranian shipping network, Oct 21 (USTreasury)
  • Updates: Nigeria Ebola entry rules (Smartraveller), Typhoon Champi in Taiwan (Smartraveller, Reuters), northern Ethiopia advice (FCDOtravelGovUK)

Also noted: West Bank detention, Yemen displacement, Hormuz shipping, Somalia, Congo, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Colombia, Germany sabotage warning and France protests (Reuters, UNOCHA, TheStudyofWar, TracTerrorism, ACLEDINFO).

This brief summarizes public reporting and is not a substitute for your organization's own risk assessment. Check the original source before making travel decisions. This brief is digitally narrated.

title: Security Risk Brief: Wednesday, October 21, 2026
notes_html:
New since yesterday's brief:

  • Sudan. The army is accused of drone strikes that reportedly killed more than 200 people, including funeral-goers; not independently confirmed (BBCAfrica).
  • Updates on yesterday's stories. Kenya now has nine confirmed Ebola cases (BBCAfrica). King Khalid Airport in Riyadh continues to be targeted (FCDOtravelGovUK). Renewed fighting is worsening humanitarian needs in northern Ethiopia (UNOCHA). A national strike is planned in Italy for 30 October (FCDOtravelGovUK).
  • US teacher freed. Russia freed Stephen Hubbard, held since 2022 (RFERL).
  • Typhoon Champi. Expected to sweep across Okinawa and the Ryukyu Islands, Japan (TravelGoC).

Also noted: fighting around Taiz and Houthi missiles at Marib, Yemen (TheStudyofWar); Iran and Pakistan border attacks (RFERL); soldier killed in Charsadda, Pakistan, and arrests after a deadly attack in Manipur, India (TracTerrorism); Pretoria tap water warning (BBCAfrica); vigilante mob violence in Kenya (ACLEDINFO); cartel arrests in Mexico (InSightCrime, TracTerrorism); drone explosives seized in Buenaventura, Colombia (TracTerrorism); Germany protest call for 31 October and IS-linked arrests in Spain (TracTerrorism); California student data breach (TheRecord_Media).

This brief summarizes public reporting and is not a substitute for your organization's own risk assessment. Check the original source before making travel decisions. This brief is digitally narrated.

title: Security Risk Brief: Tuesday, October 20, 2026
notes_html:
Top items from the past 24 hours:

  • Saudi Arabia airports disrupted. Riyadh's King Khalid International remains suspended after missile and drone attacks; Jeddah and Dammam have delays and cancellations (TravelGov). Houthis claim new strikes across the Kingdom (TracTerrorism) and are adapting tactics against Saudi air defenses (TheStudyofWar).
  • Ebola reaches Nigeria. An imported Bundibugyo Ebola case was confirmed in Abuja, with 44 contacts monitored; Nigeria is the fifth country to detect the virus (WHO). The UK updated its Tanzania advice (FCDOtravelGovUK).
  • Kenya, Lamu County. Al-Shabaab reportedly attacked Christian civilians in Baure; single report so far (TracTerrorism).
  • Ethiopia, Tigray. The TPLF threatened Ethiopian Airlines planes and federal forces are reportedly moving toward Adwa and Adigrat (criticalthreats). Crisis Group warns of possible Ethiopia and Eritrea confrontation (CrisisGroup).
  • Sahel. At least 48 civilians killed in eastern Mali in attacks attributed to Islamic State-linked militants (ACLEDINFO). JNIM took a militia base in Bam Province, Burkina Faso (TracTerrorism).

Also noted: a gang attack in Croix-des-Bouquets, Haiti left four Salvadoran soldiers from the international force missing (InSightCrime); possible protests across Italy (TravelGov); Serbia election protest risk on 25 October (Smartraveller); a CISA and FBI advisory on SafePay ransomware (CISAgov); M6.6 and M6.3 quakes off Vanuatu (USGS_Quakes).

This brief summarizes public reporting and is not a substitute for your organization's own risk assessment. Check the original source before making travel decisions. This brief is digitally narrated.

Questions? Reach Concilium at info@concilium.us.
